source: Redi-Rock Design Resource Manual V20 (2020), 'Standard Batter Gravity Walls', pp. 94-141 -- read via pdftotext/page images. The width series (28 in / 41 in / 60 in) and the 5 deg standard batter (1-5/8 in = 41 mm setback per course) ARE stated in the manual. Block COURSE HEIGHT and UNIT WEIGHT are NOT stated in the pages reviewed (only pre-computed max-height tables were present, no methodology or dimensioned section); the values below are typical placeholders for a solid/grouted gravity block course, not transcribed from any manufacturer data sheet. This catalogue is deliberately manufacturer-agnostic -- treat every row as a starting point and replace height/unit_weight with the actual manufacturer's data sheet values before issuing a design. See austruct.tools.gravity_wall.blocks module docstring.
